issue86.decision: HIG does not derive direction on its own. HIGProvider keeps following I18nManager.isRTL when `direction` is unset, so an app that disallows RTL (I18nManager.allowRTL(false) or android:supportsRtl="false") is never flipped. Hosts that support RTL pass `direction={localeDirection(getLocales()[0])}`: `localeDirection` (exported from @bloxwap/hig-contracts and @bloxwap/hig-native/provider) returns expo-localization's textDirection, else derives it from the tag's script or language, else undefined (HIGProvider then keeps its default). The native gallery passes it; docs/foundations/localization.md documents the recipe.

issue88.finding: The Xcode Dynamic Type audit finding on the gallery's Amount (BTC) RCTUITextField (68 on RN 0.81.5, 0 on 0.83.10 in #68) changes with React Native's enableFontScaleChangesUpdatingLayout feature flag.
evidence: ReactNativeFeatureFlagsDefaults.h: enableFontScaleChangesUpdatingLayout() returns false in react-native 0.81.5 and true in 0.82.0 and 0.83.10 (npm tarballs; github.com/react/react-native tags v0.82.0, v0.83.0).
react/react-native#53324 (686d14f, "Enable enableFontScaleChangesUpdatingLayout by default", changelog [General][Changed]) is contained in v0.82.0 and not in v0.81.5.

RCTTextInputComponentView.mm traitCollectionDidChange (identical in 0.81.5 and 0.83.10) re-applies defaultTextAttributes with RCTFontSizeMultiplier() when preferredContentSizeCategory changes, only when that flag is on; SurfaceHandler.cpp also re-measures text when fontSizeMultiplier changes under the same flag.

No other RN 0.81.5 -> 0.83.10 change touches TextInput font scaling: RCTUITextField.mm is unchanged; RCTTextInputComponentView.mm, RCTFontUtils.mm, RCTAttributedTextUtils.mm and TextAttributes differ only in formatting, inputAccessoryView reset and a default font resolver hook. Neither version sets adjustsFontForContentSizeCategory on the backing field; react/react-native#57426, which would, is unmerged (upstream audit report: react/react-native#51612, open).
issue88.conclusion: On 0.83 the native field updates its font in process when the content size category changes, which the audit accepts; on 0.81.5 it changes only after the next React render. This is inferred from source: Apple does not document the audit heuristic, and the flag was not toggled in isolation on the Simulator.

issue89.method: fixtures/native/native-verification.ts recordingAudioBackend counts, per cue, play() calls, playbackStatusUpdate events, statuses whose playing turns true (starts) and didJustFinish statuses; a repeat is a didJustFinish with no play() call and no playing status since that player's previous didJustFinish. feedbackCalls reads the `Sound counts:` diagnostics line after the four toggles.
issue89.conclusion: Not a second play: on SDK 54 each tick has one play() call and one playing start, followed by two didJustFinish statuses with nothing between them.
issue89.source: expo-audio 1.1.1 android/.../AudioPlayer.kt currentStatus() sets didJustFinish to (playbackState == STATE_ENDED) on every status, and both onIsPlayingChanged(false) and onPlaybackStateChanged(STATE_ENDED) send a status when a cue ends. expo-audio 55.0.18 sets didJustFinish false in currentStatus(), sends it only from onPlaybackStateChanged on the transition into STATE_ENDED, and skips the transient isPlaying=false status at the end.
issue89.hig: @bloxwap/hig-feedback does not listen to playback status (packages/feedback/src/native.ts: preload, seekTo(0), play). No de-duplication is added; if HIG ever relies on completion it must de-duplicate didJustFinish for expo-audio 1.1 (docs/feedback/adapters.md).
issue89.pending: Tick dispatch timing and audible output on devices for both SDKs (bloxwap/hig#55).
